The main.yml currently in your repository is the older v13.0 version.
The previous simplified upload package also omitted four test files required by the new workflow.

1. In GitHub, open:
   .github/workflows
   Upload and replace:
   main.yml
   from folder 1_UPLOAD_TO_DOT_GITHUB_WORKFLOWS

2. In GitHub, open:
   scripts
   Upload all four files from folder 2_UPLOAD_TO_SCRIPTS

3. Commit the changes.

4. Go to GitHub → Actions → Import all source data → Run workflow.

The new run should display five jobs:
FAOSTAT, WHO, UNESCO UIS, ILOSTAT, and Natural Earth.
